notes: Arjuna in penance — Ep 09 face family; no peacock; no gold breastplate. Kirata = hunter disguise of Shiva; reveal is luminous blessing not horror. Comic mythology only.

arjuna.face: Young archer, thin dark mustache, focused calm — same face family as Ep 09 lock, comic mythology
arjuna.hair: Black warrior topknot — no peacock feather in penance (topknot, not battle crown)
arjuna.costume: Cream ascetic / exile dhoti — not gold battle armor; bow and quiver when fighting

kirata.face: Rugged mountain hunter, strong jaw, fierce comic eyes — charming mythology, not photoreal
kirata.hair: Wild dark hair or simple hunter topknot
kirata.costume: Leaf-and-hide mountain hunter dress, bow — disguise of Shiva until reveal

shiva.face: Divine serene fierce beauty, soft third-eye glow optional, calm blessing smile — not horror
shiva.hair: Jata matted locks with crescent moon; Ganga soft stream optional
shiva.costume: Tiger skin or white ash, rudraksha, trident, luminous cream-gold aura

boar.face: Stylized wild boar, fierce comic mythology
